sloka: दुधुवे च स रोमाणि चकम्पे चाचलोपमः ।ननाद सुमहानादं सुमहानिव तोयदः ॥५-१-३२॥
transliteration: dudhuve ca sa romāṇi cakampe cācalopamaḥ ।nanāda sumahānādaṁ sumahāniva toyadaḥ ॥5-1-32॥

translations.english: Hanuman, huge as a mountain moved his body and shook the hair on his body, thundering like a cloud.
